changes.trigger: TRAIN negative 'אני שוכר דירה בבניין שעומד לעבור תמא 38' matched the description on 'תמא 38' with NO exclusion clause available to rebut it. The description positively scoped to owners but never excluded renters, so a renter's query would have been claimed by a skill that cannot serve it.
changes.change: Added an explicit renter exclusion to both descriptions: 'אל תשתמשו אם אתם שוכרים ולא בעלי הדירה' / 'Do NOT use for a renter rather than an owner'.
changes.cost: Offset by dropping the parenthetical cross-reference '(use israeli-home-defect-report)' from the EN description; the cross-reference is retained in the SKILL.md body. EN description 933 to 935 chars, still under the 950 author target.

changes.trigger: The same eval exposed a naming defect rather than a description defect: the original slug 'urban-renewal-tenant-guide' uses 'tenant', which in English means a renter, while the skill is owner-side only and explicitly excludes renters. The slug contradicted the content and would mis-route.
changes.change: Renamed to 'israeli-urban-renewal-owner-guide'. This also brings it into line with the legal-tech repo convention, where the skills are prefixed 'israeli-'.
changes.cost: Overlap gate, evidence gate and legal gate re-run against the new slug.

overfit_check.method: The renter exclusion was derived from a TRAIN query. The TEST set contains a second renter query, so that clause is partially leaked across the split.
overfit_check.honest_assessment: The TEST renter query has zero topical overlap with the description (no urban-renewal vocabulary at all), so it would be excluded with or without the added clause. It is therefore weak confirmation, and the load-bearing test of that clause is the TRAIN query. Treat the renter boundary as validated by construction rather than by held-out evidence.
overfit_check.remaining_test_items: The other three TEST rows exercise phrases not touched in round 1 and pass on the unmodified parts of the description.
